column1: # Easy Singlish shortcuts: letters<TAB>what they stand for. A shortcut is offered first when its letters
# are typed exactly. For short forms that the engine cannot work out by itself (it already finds words
# typed without their vowels: hri → හරි, gdr → ගෙදර) and for English names of places.
# Hand-written; add freely. Several lines with the same letters are offered in this order.
